questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the side shown by the arrow. There is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead that you must drive around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the speed shown on the sign (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that you cannot park in this area. You must obey all regulation signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to drive only in the direction shown by the arrow. You must follow this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights always follow the same order: red on top (or left), yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom (or right).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic will merge from the right into your lane. Be ready to slow down and make room for incoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance areas. They help drivers navigate safely through these zones. Traffic fines in these areas are often doubled.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must yield the right-of-way at this sign. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross before you go. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roadways. You must come to a complete stop and wait until it is safe to proceed through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm downward, they are signaling they will stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a crossroad ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means an action is not allowed. This sign prohibits U-turns where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at intersections with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the upcoming bridge is too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully and be prepared.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Triangle signs pointing downward mean you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that one lane is ending. Traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield the right-of-way. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overhead clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Begin to slow down when you see this warning.
